Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a premium RAW, POWERFUL football-club wall mural background as raster artwork. The first reference is STYLE ONLY: preserve its white cracked plaster and single deep club blue #03438A palette, but make the hand-painted energy substantially STRONGER: HUGE bold diagonal sweeping dry-brush strokes, rough bristle gaps, torn screenprinted edges, broad distressed ink shapes, splashes, chipped gritty plaster. BOLD expressive coarse photographic screenprint mixed organically into paint. Architecture must remain highly recognizable, geometrically faithful to the photographic landmark references. Do not turn buildings into fine technical drawings, etchings or engraved line illustrations. Never invent a generic substitute building. Preserve physical openings, landmark proportions and distinctive silhouettes. Paint texture can distress surfaces but never destroy landmark recognition.
Colors: WHITE plaster and ONLY DEEP CLUB BLUE #03438A; blue densities may vary. No colored photo patches, rainbow hues, gray/brown separate ink, additional slogans, UI, people, vehicles, birds, watermarks, frames, or added logos. Only existing physical building signs/crest, where asked, may remain as part of building. The result is artwork only; do not draw text/UI placeholders.
Use maximum available native output resolution. Wide 16:9 composition; requested target 3840 x 2160 pixels at the largest available native size. Intended website overlays: a player occupies LEFT x0-30% from y20-100%, the title overlays RIGHT x30-100% y0-28%, text x30-48% y35-90%, cards x50-98% y30-95%. These are layout constraints only, DO NOT DRAW THESE OVERLAYS. Therefore place the main recognizable architectural feature UP HIGH LEFT, not bottom-left. Reserve quiet WHITE plaster x35-95% overall, especially the right upper third and central body. Large landmark body fades to white lower down. Concentrate extremely powerful broad blue brush sweeps at outermost margins and lower corners, with bristle texture spilling into the landmark edges. The visible primary feature must not be a tiny polite postcard. Mobile left crop must retain the high-left landmark. Reference roles: image 1 style only; images 2,3,4 authoritative views of the SAME canteen, image 5 actual entrance gate.
Primary subject: genuine Duindorp S.V. canteen facade, HIGH LEFT x1-44%, y3-50%. Low ONE-STORY FLAT roof, brick end wall, white horizontal fascia and thick blue fascia strip, exactly the real window and door structure. The large physical fascia sign must read verbatim "DUINDORP S.V." with spacing and punctuation, all letters fully visible inside x5-42%, y16-32%, not clipped, not at the bottom. Sign lettering is chunky and photographically faithful. Keep the physical small club crest on fascia. Use a near-frontal view informed by all canteen photos; preserve actual proportions, no sloped roof or invented building. Window structure beneath sign becomes broad distressed blue/white blocks then fades rapidly to white by y52%. A small secondary actual open overhead entrance gate from image 5 sits at extreme right edge y65-88%, mostly secondary; physical sign reads "WELKOM BIJ DUINDORP S.V." if legible. Do not reproduce photo borders, sponsor ads, crowd, or watermark. The primary canteen sign should be the focal readable shape despite raw brush energy.
